title: The Tabernacle's Planks, Corners, and Crossbars
description: The instructions continue with the construction of the tabernacle's solid frame: twenty planks of acacia wood on each side facing south and north, with silver sockets; six planks at the back facing west, plus two additional corner planks; and five crossbars of gold-covered acacia wood on each side to hold the structure together. Finally, Moses is reminded to set up the tabernacle according to the pattern shown to him on the mountain.
